name: To Tickets
description: Breaks a plan, spec or conversation into tracer-bullet tickets with blocking edges and publishes them to the configured issue tracker.
longDescription: Each ticket is a **vertical slice** that cuts through every layer (schema, API, UI, tests), demoable alone and sized to one context window; prefactoring goes first. Wide refactors are sequenced as **expand–contract** instead: add the new form, migrate call sites in batches sized by blast radius, delete the old form last. You approve granularity and blocking edges before publication. Local mode writes one file per ticket under `.scratch/<feature>/issues/`; GitHub or Linear get one issue each, native blocking links and the `ready-for-agent` label. Needs `/setup-matt-pocock-skills` for the tracker.
